title: 卢卡斯影业前总裁肯尼迪谈星战未来
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: So it was about 15 years ago that George Lucas brought you into Lucasfilm was president.
segments.zh: 大约15年前，乔治·卢卡斯把你带进卢卡斯影业，担任总裁。

segments.en: And then sold the company to Disney. And then some folks might remember.
segments.zh: 后来把公司卖给了迪士尼。有些人可能还记得。

segments.en: He kind of went through some stuff. He described it as like selling his kids.
segments.zh: 他经历了一些波折。他形容这就像卖掉自己的孩子。

segments.en: He was conflicted. And now earlier this year, you step aside as president of Lucasfilm.
segments.zh: 他内心矛盾。今年早些时候，你卸任了卢卡斯影业总裁。

segments.en: You pass it to Dave Filoni and Linwen Brennan.
segments.zh: 你把职位交给了戴夫·菲洛尼和林温·布伦南。

segments.en: So I'm wondering how are you feeling? Are you feeling a little bittersweet about it?
segments.zh: 所以我想知道你感觉如何？是否有些百感交集？

segments.en: I suppose there's a bit of relief.
These jobs are not easy. And stepping into something like that that George had created was an incredible challenge.
segments.zh: 这些工作并不容易。接手乔治创造的东西是巨大的挑战。

segments.en: And I'll tell you a story that I thought was actually kind of amusing is when I first said to him, so George,
segments.zh: 我告诉你一个我觉得挺有趣的故事。当我第一次对他说，乔治，

segments.en: the stories that we're going to do next. I mean, is there anything I should look at?
segments.zh: 接下来要做的故事。我是说，有什么我应该看看的吗？

segments.en: Should I have some sense? He said, no, no, it's all here.
segments.zh: 我该有点头绪吗？他说，不，不，都在这里。

segments.en: And I said, OK, well, that's going to be interesting to try to mine that.
segments.zh: 我说，好吧，那要挖掘出来会很有趣。

segments.en: He did have a story, he had story treatments, right? We had a couple of paragraphs.
segments.zh: 他确实有个故事，他有故事大纲，对吧？我们有两段。

segments.en: He didn't really have story treatments. But the amazing thing is that he put together an incredible company.
segments.zh: 他其实没有故事大纲。但了不起的是，他组建了一家不可思议的公司。

segments.en: And there's amazing people inside the company Dave being one of them.
segments.zh: 公司里有很多了不起的人，戴夫就是其中之一。
